writingPrompts.label: HS Junior

writingPrompts.label: AP

writingPrompts.label: College Freshman
writingPrompts.text: Situate Chapter XVII within its historical and literary context and argue how the chapter's treatment of doubts and preparations responds to that context. writingPrompts.label: College Sophomore
